An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.
2014_spells.blur.effectSummary: Give a creature advantage on attack rolls for the duration
2014_spells.blur.fullDescription: Using 1 action, your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you; An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight. The effect lasts for up to 1 minute; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
